retained: Current recording, raw upcoming queue and previous history are separate. Only upcoming items can be reordered.
Clear removes only upcoming items and priority-next; the current recording and previous queue remain.
Reordering preserves current recording, decoder, position and pause; priority-next and the existing original shuffle planner retain their own policy.
mobileAdaptations: Native Edit drag handles replace mouse dragging; swipe removal and the existing play-next menu remain available.
Owner, queue revision, current recording and active resolver fence every delayed queue-panel action.
Queue mutations flow through the existing checkpoint writer without restarting audio.
